description: This file implements an ArgillaLogger class for sending logs to Argilla as part of a larger machine learning or data logging system. The class manages batching, transformation, and asynchronous HTTP communication with an Argilla backend, integrating with other litellm components.

classes.name: ArgillaLogger
classes.description: A custom batch logger class that sends logs and payload data to Argilla, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operation, with batch management and data transformation.

methods.name: is_serializable(value)
methods.description: Determines if a value is serializable, excluding types like coroutine, function, generator, and Pydantic's BaseModel.

methods.name: validate_argilla_transformation_object( self, argilla_transformation_object: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Validates that the transformation object dict has values only in SUPPORTED_PAYLOAD_FIELDS.

methods.name: ArgillaCredentialsObject get_credentials_from_env( self, argilla_api_key: Optional[str], argilla_dataset_name: Optional[str], argilla_base_url: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Retrieves Argilla credentials and dataset info from parameters or environment variables, validating existence and correctness.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_chat_messages( self, payload: StandardLoggingPayload )
methods.description: Extracts chat messages from the payload, handling different message formats.

methods.name: str get_str_response(self, payload: StandardLoggingPayload)
methods.description: Extracts response text from the payload, whether a string or dict.

methods.name: Optional[ArgillaItem] _prepare_log_data( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time )
methods.description: Prepares a log item for Argilla, transforming payload data based on argilla_transformation_object.

methods.name: _send_batch(self)
methods.description: Sends the current batch of logs to Argilla synchronously.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Handles logging of a successful event, possibly batching or skipping based on sampling.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronous version of log_success_event, prepares data and manages queue asynchronously.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Logs a failure event asynchronously, similar to success_event but for failures.

methods.name: async_send_batch(self)
methods.description: Asynchronously sends the current log batch to Argilla.

methods.name: __init__( self, argilla_api_key: Optional[str] = None, argilla_dataset_name: Optional[str] = None, argilla_base_url: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
